p: Disney's newest theme park, which opened in 2016, features eight themed areas: Mickey Avenue, Gardens of Imagination, Fantasyland, Treasure Cove, Adventure Isle, Tomorrowland, Toy Story Land and the City of Zootopia. While similar to…

Approved in 2009, Disney sought to build a theme park in Shanghai that was both "authentically Disney [and] distinctly Chinese". It opened in mid-June 2016 and received 5.6 million visitors that year, an average of around 28,000 a day.…
